assumptions: EPD is a native encounter expectation, not measured hero average DPS.
All three damage bands are evaluated for every hero. No unsupported fixed per-class DPS is assigned.
HP-only kill rounds omit boss Block/healing, revival use-counter details and player control; not fight-duration predictions.
Exposure indices use native probability tables, an independent cooldown approximation and native HScript gates along linear HP loss.
They ignore shared card costs, AI skill ordering, player shields, Tough, dodge, lightning random rolls and acquired equipment.
Lightning is valued at maximum. Fire assumes one immediate use; poison sensitivity assumes no cleanse.
Counter uses accumulated own missing life, not damage of the previous hit. It is once per even boss turn.
World HP growth is the native startingLife + addedLifePerRegion; optional health upgrades are omitted.
No win-rate claims. World references are same-world/native mechanics comparisons, not a full native baseline simulation.
